judge.evidence_requirement: For every routing assertion, quote or reference exact Skill lifecycle evidence; the description and output prose do not prove activation.

dimensions.description: Selects Agents File Writer for creating, improving, reviewing, scoping, or splitting agent-facing guidance files.
Leaves human-facing prose, Agent Skill authoring, and unrelated project documentation to their owning outcomes.

evals.name: create project agent guidance
evals.prompt: Create a project AGENTS.md that tells future agents how to change this repository.
evals.expected_output: Agents File Writer activates for creating project-scoped agent guidance.
expectations: The host records Agents File Writer activation by its canonical name.

evals.name: refine AGENTS guidance
evals.prompt: Review and refine the existing AGENTS.md and its directly referenced agent guidance so the rules match current repository behavior.
evals.expected_output: Agents File Writer activates for refining existing agent guidance.
expectations: The host records Agents File Writer activation for the guidance refinement request.

evals.name: canonical direct invocation
evals.prompt:
/agents-file-writer

Review the applicable AGENTS.md files and return the guidance migration ledger.
evals.expected_output: Direct canonical invocation selects Agents File Writer.
expectations: The host records invocation of Agents File Writer by its exact canonical name.

evals.name: human-facing prose exclusion
evals.prompt: Rewrite this release announcement for customers so it leads with the answer and uses less jargon.
evals.expected_output: Agents File Writer stays inactive because To Humans owns human-facing expression.
expectations: The host does not record Agents File Writer activation for a human-facing prose request.

evals.name: Agent Skill package exclusion
evals.prompt: Create a new Agent Skill package with SKILL.md, frontmatter, and evaluation cases.
evals.expected_output: Agents File Writer stays inactive because Skill Writing owns Agent Skill authoring.
expectations: The host does not record Agents File Writer activation for an Agent Skill package request.

evals.name: ambient guidance mention is not activation
evals.prompt: What does an AGENTS.md file generally contain?
evals.expected_output: Agents File Writer stays inactive because the user asked for an explanation rather than guidance work.
expectations: The host does not record Agents File Writer activation for a general explanatory question.
